title: PPG-MS22 — Operability + SLO + Circuit Breakers
description: Closes the operability exposure surfaced by R08 scrutiny (score 64). Defines SLOs/SLIs for the wizard + emit + ensemble verify. Adds circuit breakers around all external adapters. Wires watchdog + min-sample gate into MS11 telemetry. Splits CI into PR-affected fast lane + nightly full-corpus lane. Expands MS12 runbook to 10 failure modes.
rationale: Closes the operability exposure surfaced by R08 scrutiny (score 64). Defines SLOs/SLIs for the wizard + emit + ensemble verify. Adds circuit breakers around all external adapters. Wires watchdog + min-sample gate into MS11 telemetry. Splits CI into PR-affected fast lane + nightly full-corpus lane. Expands MS12 runbook to 10 failure modes.

units.title: SLO/SLI sheet + error-budget tracking
units.scope: Wizard p95 <8s emit, ensemble verify p95 <45s, drift canary FP rate <2%, telemetry freshness <10min. Error-budget tracker with alerting.

units.title: Circuit breakers on all external adapters
units.scope: Fusion/Vericut/NCSIMUL/FOCAS/OPC-UA/MTConnect — circuit breaker (open/half-open/closed) + timeout + fallback to PRISM-only verdict; degraded-mode banner in wizard.

units.title: MS11 telemetry watchdog + min-sample gate
units.scope: Watchdog alerts on >15min ingestor silence; min-sample gate (n≥10) before delta emit; structured backoff/retry/dead-letter per source.

units.title: CI shard: PR-affected fast lane + nightly full-corpus
units.scope: PR feedback <3min via affected-only test selection; nightly full 50-program corpus + drift detector. vitest --shard.

units.title: MS12 runbook expanded to 10 failure modes
units.scope: Add: golden-corpus seal corruption, drift FP storm, sidecar SHA collision, override DB partition leak, day-4 cutover-fail rollback, telemetry stall, license server down, 2-person rule lockout, tenant migration, multi-shop conflict.

units.title: Deployment cadence spec + canary rollout
units.scope: Sidecar daily, post engines weekly, physics constants gated by drift-PR-comment-approval; canary 25%→50%→full with auto-revert on SLO breach.

completion_criteria: SLO sheet published; error-budget burn rate alerted to on-call
Every external adapter wrapped in circuit breaker with verified fallback
MS11 telemetry watchdog catches 15min stall; min-sample gate prevents 0-sample deltas
PR feedback <3min p95; nightly corpus runs in <30min
Runbook covers 10 failure modes with concrete remediation
Canary deployment with auto-revert verified on synthetic SLO breach
